Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a business and occupation tax deduction for amounts physicians receive from medicaid or medicare when the amount is less than the cost of oncology prescription drugs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a business and occupation taxdeduction for amounts physicians receive from medicaid or medicare whenthe amount is less than the cost of certain prescription drugs; andadding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing tax there may be deducted from the measure of taxamounts received by physicians licensed under chapter 18.71 RCW forphysicianadministered oncology prescription drugs, when the amountreceived is less than the cost of the prescription drug covered under:(a) A medical assistance program established under RCW 74.09.500 or (b)a federal medicare program authorized under Title XVIII of the federalsocial security act. (2) The deduction authorized by this section does not apply toamounts received from patient copayments or patient deductibles. (3) The physician must keep records necessary for the department to p. 1 SB 5912verify eligibility under this section.
